entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Remember that one time when you were[n]told to go to confession? Things were pretty[n]crazy with you...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But it turned out for the better.[n]That's what's amazing about you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You want to go for a final confession?[n]That's fine, but don't you want to see[n]everyone else?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yup, when I think of church, I think of[n]the organ. I wish someone would have[n]played us something as a send-off.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need to be here right now,[n]do you? Come on, let's head somewhere[n]else!
entries.uk: Тобі ж зараз нема чого тут робити,[n]правда? Ну ж бо, ходімо кудись-інде!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's wrong? Come on, we should go say[n]goodbye to the others!
entries.uk: Що таке? Ну ж бо, треба піти[n]попрощатися з іншими!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We can't wait any longer... We have to[n]prepare, and fast!
entries.uk: Чекати більше не можна... Треба[n]готуватися, і швидко!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Did you want to go someplace else?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, is there something you still need[n]to do here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You might get yelled at if you play it[n]without permission...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What is this room? Is it some kind of[n]storage area?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, you want to use the confessional?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But wait... The priest isn't here to listen[n]to confessions.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It'll take a little while to call someone over.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, who are you gonna have remember[n]a forgotten skill?
